ops.title: daemonkit: Client.close GoAway exchange ignores the caller's context
ops.description:
Found by the cc-sync install-probe refutation (Run wf_d7092e6c-714). In daemonkit v0.23.0 internal/wire/client.go:645, close() derives the GoAway send and acknowledgement wait from context.WithoutCancel(parent). That contradicts Close's own godoc. A peer that rejects a call and then stalls its GoAway ack holds the caller past its deadline or cancellation for up to WriteTimeout (10s by default); the cc-sync repro measured ~1.2s. It is identical on daemonkit origin/main.

Prepared fix, UNTESTED and UNPUSHED: /Users/yasyf/.claude/worktrees/daemonkit/goaway-deadline, branch cc-sync/goaway-deadline from tag v0.23.0, local commit f82757488319b29e12e831fde11022690212ece4. It uses context.WithTimeout(parent, c.codec.WriteTimeout) and adds TestClientCloseHonorsContextAwaitingGoAway. Tests were not run because the permission classifier denied 'go test' in that fresh clone ('Code from External'); do not bypass that denial.

To finish:
1. With user approval, run GOWORK=off go test -race ./internal/wire. Confirm the new test fails without the fix and passes with it, then run the full test suite and lint.
2. Push, and either pin a pseudo-version in cc-sync or land it on main with a release.
3. Commit the relay reproducer (/tmp/cc-sync-review-install-retirement.txt) as a cc-sync regression test in internal/helperclient.

The same WithoutCancel pattern exists at client.go:538 (ClientCall.cancel), but that is fire-and-forget and never blocks a caller.

ops.text: daemonkit Close returns within its context deadline when the peer never acks GoAway (TestClientCloseHonorsContextAwaitingGoAway fails before, passes after)
cc-sync install readiness wait ends within ~200ms of the caller deadline in the relay reproducer
